name: AIST++
summary: 带音乐和多视角视频的三维舞蹈运动序列，提供关节旋转、根节点轨迹和逐帧关键点。
summaryEn: 3D dance motion sequences paired with music and multiview video, providing joint rotations, root trajectories, and framewise keypoints.
scale: 1,408 motion sequences, 10 dance genres and 9 camera views
scaleZh: 1,408 段运动序列、10 类舞蹈、9 个相机视角
organizations: Google Research and University of California, Berkeley
organizationsZh: 谷歌研究院与加州大学伯克利分校
license: Videos/music: AIST terms; annotations and SMPL use require separate review
licenseZh: 视频和音乐遵循 AIST 条款；标注及 SMPL 使用需分别核查
access: Official annotations and video download script
accessZh: 官方标注下载及视频下载脚本
verdict: 音乐条件人体运动预测
wmNote: 时间对齐的关节与根轨迹适合运动生成和预测；音乐不是物理控制动作。
wmNoteEn: Aligned joints and root trajectories support motion generation and prediction; music is not a physical control action.
